title: Zyla API Hub
description: Discover and call 10,000+ production APIs from one MCP server. Pay-per-call billing for AI agents.
summary: Discover and call 10,000+ production APIs from one MCP server. Pay-per-call billing for AI agents.
offersHint: Discover and call 10,000+ production APIs from one MCP server. Pay-per-call billing for AI agents. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.zylalabs.com/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer YOUR_ZYLA_API_KEY — optional for discovery tools (search_catalog, get_api_info, browse_catalog, list_categories, register); required for call_api and account tools. Get a key with the register tool or at https://zylalabs.com/agents/connect

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer YOUR_ZYLA_API_KEY — optional for discovery tools (search_catalog, get_api_info, browse_catalog, list_categories, register); required for call_api and account tools. Get a key with the register tool or at https://zylalabs.com/agents/connect

toolsPreview.name: search_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Semantic search across ALL 10,000+ public APIs on Zyla API Hub. Natural-language queries work best (e.g. "validate an email address", "get stock prices"). Returns matching APIs ranked by relevance with their ID, name, description, category, price per successful call (USD), average latency (ms), and endpoints summary.

toolsPreview.name: get_api_info
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific Zyla API by its numeric ID. Returns the API name, description, category, price per successful call (USD), average latency (ms), and all endpoints with their parameters, example values, and a formal JSON Schema (input_schema) for argument validation.

toolsPreview.name: call_api
toolsPreview.description: Call an API endpoint on Zyla API Hub. Requires the user's API key and a credit card on file. Billing is pay-per-successful-request: you only pay for 2xx responses. Each API has its own price per call (shown in get_api_info), and every successful response includes cost_usd — the exact amount billed for that call. There are no monthly subscriptions or minimums — usage is charged to your credit card automatically. If a 402 error is returned with a payment_url, the user MUST open that URL in their browser to add a credit card before retrying. Pass the api_id, endpoint_id, HTTP method, and parameters.

toolsPreview.name: browse_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Browse the full Zyla API Hub catalog with pagination. Use this to explore ALL public APIs beyond the top 500. Supports filtering by category and search keyword. Returns paginated results with total count and page info.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all available API categories on Zyla API Hub with the real count of public APIs in each. Use the category names returned here as the "category" parameter in browse_catalog to filter APIs by category. Example categories: Sports, Finance, Data, Science, etc.

toolsPreview.name: register
toolsPreview.description: Register a new Zyla API Hub account directly from the AI agent. Returns an API key AND a payment_url. The user MUST open the payment_url in their browser to add a credit card before making any API calls. Billing model: pay-per-successful-request with no monthly fees or minimums. Each API has its own per-call price. The credit card is only charged at the end of the billing cycle for actual usage. No authentication required to call this tool.

toolsPreview.name: account_status
toolsPreview.description: Check the current user's account status, billing, and usage. Returns plan info, API call count, the amount consumed this billing cycle in USD (amount_consumed_this_cycle_usd), whether a credit card is on file, and any failed/pending payments. Use this to diagnose why API calls are blocked (missing card or failed payment). Requires the user's API key in the Authorization header.

toolsPreview.name: get_payment_url
toolsPreview.description: Get a Stripe Checkout URL so the user can add or update their credit card. REQUIRED after registration and whenever a 402 error occurs. The user must open the returned URL in their browser to add/update their card. Billing is pay-per-successful-request: no subscriptions, no monthly fees, no minimums. You are only charged for successful API responses (2xx). Prices vary per API (see get_api_info). API calls are blocked until a valid credit card is on file.
